purpose: Command and role briefs for Devin CLI agents working inside MOIRA's nonlinear research runtime.

master.purpose: Coordinate nonlinear research cycles without reducing MOIRA to a linear task list.
must_do: Run python3 tools/moira_runtime.py capsule --format text before dispatch decisions.
Respect tasks.json as the execution ledger and dev-docs/todos.json as the TODO ledger.
Before any book processing, verify or build that book's full_path_tree.json and path audit. No path list, no Worker dispatch.
Treat STOP_ALLOWED from one layer as insufficient if another layer still reports queued, leased or busy work.
common_mistakes: Treating a Worker completion as semantic PASS before Auditor review.
Forgetting that S-n system evolution is nonlinear and may generate new tasks.
Sending a Worker into book text before PathListGate has passed.
Launching more Workers while stale leased tasks or stale tmux sessions have not been reconciled.

worker.purpose: Absorb one bounded experience package and report how the formal system evolved.
must_read: AGENTS.md §工作协议：系统自我成长的 SOP
must_do: Refuse正文处理 if the assigned package lacks a path ID, source file, line range and audited full_path_tree.json entry.
Produce evidence for dimensions, maturity and computability.
Create or update audit artifacts before claiming completion.
Use checkpoints for long-running work and exact line coverage when a line range is assigned.
common_mistakes: Reading a whole book freely instead of the assigned path.
Only summarizing source text without extracting operators, sets or propositions.
Filling SOP fields mechanically without explaining the thinking process.
Using AI judgment where code or source text should be the evidence.

auditor.purpose: Check whether Worker output actually passes MOIRA's semantic and SOP gates.
must_do: Separate execution completion from semantic PASS.
Check that the Worker output covers the assigned path ID and no unassigned text.
Check dimensions, maturity and computability independently.
Write explicit PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL or BLOCKED evidence.
common_mistakes: Approving a Worker because a tmux session ended.
Approving正文处理 when the book has no audited full path list.
Failing to record the exact evidence path.

stop.purpose: Prevent premature stop in a live nonlinear research run.
must_do: Stop only when queued, leased and busy counts are all zero and no protocol anchor fails.
common_mistakes: Stopping because no active terminal output is visible.

path-list.purpose: Build and audit a full path list before any book is processed.
must_do: Identify the target book directory under dev-docs/原典/.
Generate or verify full_path_tree.json before正文 processing.
Ensure every path has a stable ID, source file, line range and hash or equivalent verifiable locator.
Audit coverage to remainder=0 before compiling Worker packets.
common_mistakes: Starting Worker reading before path coverage is known.
Treating schema headings as enough when line ranges and hashes are missing.
Letting Worker choose its own reading range.
